summary: Model card cleanups shipped (d2800e4c + 01014c1e, npm test 492/492), left in validating for the users own Electron eye test. Wan 2.2 Smooth lost its one-entry Operations toggle: wan-22 was the last commonDeps+operations{} model and is now FLAT to the identical dep set, taking the whole per-op install UI with it. isOperationInstalled gained a supportedOps guard - without it a flat wan would answer YES for the deprecated t2v_ms and re-open MPI-453. minVramGb overrides the fitted VRAM floor; both H3 cards state 12GB (~48GB RAM) where the fit rounded to 16. The H/B/L letter now needs an INSTALLED same-NAME model in another tier, not merely a shared modelFamily - today only LTX 2.3 qualifies. MiniMax H3 re-tiered high to balanced. Chips relabel on model/op change, including the fast-path hole where a badge element that never existed could not be created.
